local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local Actor=types.Actor
local t=0;local age=0;local frames=0;local floor=nil;local peak=nil;local airborne=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 age=age+dt;frames=frames+1;t=t+dt;if t<.05 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original entrance jump')
 local ground=Actor.isOnGround(self);local z=self.position.z
 if age>=3 and frames>=30 and ground and not floor then floor=z;peak=z end
 if not floor then return end
 peak=math.max(peak,z)
 if not ground and z>floor+5 then airborne=true;print('AcroProbe airborne') end
 print('AcroProbe sample ground='..tostring(ground)..' z='..z..' floor='..floor..' peak='..peak..' base='..types.NPC.stats.skills.acrobatics(self).base..' progress='..types.NPC.stats.skills.acrobatics(self).progress..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 if not airborne then print('AcroProbe ready') elseif ground then print('AcroProbe landed') end
end}}}}
